# Within Ten

> A hyperlocal weekend/trip planner for Chicago-area ZIP codes. Aggregates village news, public library events, and park district programs per town, rebuilt automatically (usually multiple times a week), so it stays current without a human keeping it that way.

## Regions
- [Arlington Heights (60005)](https://withintenmiles.com/arlington-heights-60005/): Village news, library events, and park district programs — a short drive from Mount Prospect.
- [Des Plaines (60016)](https://withintenmiles.com/des-plaines-60016/): City news, library events, and park district programs — just north of O'Hare.
- [Mount Prospect (60056)](https://withintenmiles.com/mount-prospect-60056/): Village news, library events, and park district programs.
- [Palatine (60067)](https://withintenmiles.com/palatine-60067/): Village news, library events, and park district programs — northwest of Mount Prospect.
